meta.note: Package 36 P4, package 37 P2: the races of the game module godbound (Wp_claude/RACES_SOURCE.md); only what affects the character; texts of narrative abilities in English (the owner's source).

abilities.name: Универсальность
abilities.text: Common to humanity: get a feat whose prerequisites you meet (prerequisites are not checked). No effects of its own: take the feat from the catalog and link the taken feat here (held by).

abilities.name: Тень короны
abilities.text: +2 to diplomacy and empathy. Each cycle 2 comfort with a reliable rear (a place where you are waited for and loved, loyal friends, relatives).

triggers.text: Shadow of the crown: +2 comfort if you have a reliable rear

abilities.name: Адреналин
abilities.text: Spend 2 BP: +2 to all rolls for an hour (turn the status on), then fatigue until rested. These BP come back only by the long rest (the short rest does not bring them back).

triggers.text: Adrenaline: spend 2 BP and turn the status on

abilities.name: Жизнь среди ужасов
abilities.text: Does not lower combat morale from critical hits and pain; once per combat may spend 2 actions not to flee because of low morale.

statuses.name: Адреналин
statuses.text: +2 to all rolls for an hour; then fatigue until rested.

abilities.text: Restores half as many HP from positive energy (every heal by the Heal button); +6 against death effects and necromancy spells; dies at 12 pain, not 8.
